# AI rules — Infra (Docker • nginx • supervisord)

Scope: `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `nginx.conf`, `supervisord.conf`, `.env.example`,
`serve-frontend.py`, `run-dev.sh` — web deployment and local serving. See
[ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) §4.4 and §5.4 for where this sits; this file is the coding
contract. The Flask app behind the proxy is governed by [AI_FLASK.md](AI_FLASK.md); the static
files it serves by [AI_FRONTEND.md](AI_FRONTEND.md).

## The Relative-URL Contract (load-bearing)

- The frontend calls `/api/*` relative; **this layer** makes that work: nginx (web) and
  `desktop/protocol.js` (desktop) both proxy `/api/*` to Flask. Any absolute or
  environment-specific URL introduced anywhere breaks the other deployment.
- nginx serves static files from the document root and proxies `/api/*` to Flask — keep that
  split in `nginx.conf`; don't add per-endpoint routes.
- Ports: web 80 (nginx), Flask 5050, dev frontend 8000 (`serve-frontend.py`). Changing a port
  means changing the env var (`BACKEND_PORT` / proxy config), never the frontend code.

## Images & Processes

- Multi-stage `Dockerfile`: backend stage installs the export toolchain (pandoc, XeLaTeX via
  `texlive-xetex`, fonts, `librsvg2-bin`) — export must work without host tools. If you add an
  export dependency, it belongs in this stage.
- Supervisor manages nginx + Flask (`supervisord.conf`); logs go to stdout/stderr; keep
  `DISABLE_FILE_LOGGING=true` as the recommended Docker setting.
- Runtime configuration comes from environment variables (`config.py` + `.env.example`) — never
  baked into the image.
- There is no `.dockerignore` yet; if the build context or image grows, add one excluding
  `node_modules/`, `venv/`, `htmlcov/`, `.git/`, `desktop/out/`.

## Secrets

- Secrets via runtime env (`.env`, gitignored) or orchestrator secrets — never baked into
  images, never echoed into logs or build output.
- `.env.example` stays in sync with `config.py` (see AI_FLASK.md) and documents every image
  variable, including the PDF font overrides (`PDF_MAIN_FONT`, `PDF_MONO_FONT`).

## Reproducibility

- Keep base images pinned by tag (`python:3.13-slim`, `nginx:alpine`); don't float to `latest`.
- A green deployment must mean the gates actually ran — never `|| true` a check away.
- No CI pipeline exists in this repo; the local test commands in [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) are the
  only gates — run them before declaring a deployable change.
